title: Sales pulse
what_to_watch: Revenue and related dashboard signals that show whether the sales pulse is on course.
why_watch: Help Revenue Operations distinguish expected movement from a business issue and decide what deserves attention.
watch_for: Revenue changes materially versus the selected comparison window.
The movement is concentrated in one product line or related segment.
A related chart corroborates the movement rather than explaining it away.
questions: Is the movement outside expected seasonal behavior?
Which related signals are most relevant to the decision?
Does this warrant a Revenue Operations response?

delivery_methods.label: Revenue Operations
delivery_methods.instructions: Notify Revenue Operations when the evidence supports a non-urgent operating response.

delivery_methods.label: Executive Escalation
delivery_methods.instructions: Escalate only when the evidence indicates severe business impact or untrustworthy data.
